candidate.definition_en: A chief bishop responsible for an archdiocese.
candidate.explanation_ar: رتبة دينية كبيرة في المسيحية، بيكون رئيس الأساقفة.

senses.definition_en: A chief bishop responsible for an archdiocese.
senses.definition_ar: رئيس الأساقفة المسؤول عن إدارة أبرشية كبرى.
examples: He was appointed as the new archbishop after years of service to the church.
The archbishop delivered a sermon on peace to the gathered congregation.
Local church leaders met with the archbishop to discuss community issues.
